verdict.rationale: Productboard's built-in agent Spark consumes at least one external MCP server: it can query Notion through "Spark's MCP connector." It also lists other Spark tool integrations such as Linear, Amplitude and Slack, though these are not stated to be MCP-based. Productboard's own MCP server is the server role and earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented ability for users to register arbitrary or custom MCP servers, client-side MCP setup docs, confirmation that the other Spark connectors use MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Query Notion live through Spark's MCP connector. Attach docs as chat context.
